reviews.title: Best digital bank in Brazil
reviews.content: Nubank offers an incredible digital banking experience. The app is intuitive, fees are transparent, and customer support through the app is responsive. The credit card with no annual fee is a game changer.
reviews.likes: No annual fee, great app, transparent fees

reviews.title: Good but needs improvement
reviews.content: The basic banking features are solid but the investment platform is lacking. Customer service can be slow during peak times. Overall a decent option for everyday banking.
